label: Esse: The distinguished respect esse: InAct x esse says that x has being
definition: The distinguished respect `esse`: `InAct x esse` says that x has being. Esse is the actuality of all things, even of forms: nothing has actuality except insofar as it is. Being 'maximal in being' and 'cause of being' are said with respect to this respect.
note: Accepted definition with a contested gloss. The declaration encodes only the dependence reading (R-dep: nothing has actuality except insofar as it is). The gloss 'esse is the actuality of all things, even of forms' is the source's (q.4 a.1 ad 3). Read strongly, it is an act-of-being thesis: R-act1 (8c64b036, esse received and limited) or R-act2 (254ee26f, intensive esse). Those readings are contested by the quantifier view and are not certified by this declaration (docs/notes/mode-of-being-subsistent-esse.md).
